description: This file is an OpenAPI (Swagger) specification in JSON format defining API endpoints, response schemas, and components related to the DECT Voice Interface in a telecom system. It details API operations for retrieving and modifying DECT Voice Interface settings, including responses, request bodies, schemas, and event definitions.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Voice.DECT.Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current status and configuration of the DECT Voice Interface, including operational status, protocol, statistics, and error responses.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Voice.DECT.Set
methods.description: Modifies the status and configuration parameters of the DECT Voice Interface.
